Meet Urban Sports Club
We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent.
But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities .
*Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!*
Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.
The opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager for our Growth Operations team to build and scale the marketing technology and automation layer powering Urban Sports Club's B2C growth.
This role sits at the intersection of CRM, marketing technology, and data activation, with a primary focus on enabling and scaling our CRM infrastructure while extending its impact across paid acquisition, product, and partnerships.
You will act as the system owner and enabler, ensuring our tools, automation, and data are fully leveraged to drive efficient, personalized, and scalable growth.

You own the CRM infrastructure, optimizing Braze for scalability, lifecycle automation, and personalization
You build and scale automated CRM and marketing workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort
You activate customer data by partnering with Segment to enable real-time audiences and data-driven growth use cases
You extend CRM audiences across paid marketing channels to drive retargeting, suppression, and lookalike strategies
You manage and integrate the MarTech stack, establishing best practices, governance, and scalable processes
You drive AI adoption by implementing use cases that enhance CRM, content creation, workflows, and personalization
You collaborate with growth, product, and partnership teams to deliver impactful, cross-channel customer activation
What you will need to succeed
You have 4–7+ years of experience in MarTech, CRM Operations, or Marketing Operations
You have hands-on experience with Braze, Segment, or similar CRM and customer data platforms
You have a strong understanding of CRM systems, marketing automation, and lifecycle marketing
You have experience working with marketing data, audience segmentation, and customer activation
You have a solid technical foundation, including APIs, integrations, and data flows.
You bring a problem-solving mindset with a focus on scalability, efficiency, and process optimization
You are passionate about applying AI to improve marketing workflows, automation, and personalization
What's in it for you
Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family.
Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle.
Extended Remote Work Options: Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices.
WorkOUT Life Balance: Take advantage of 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus two additional days for volunteering, flexible working hours, and complimentary access to our mental health provider Open Up.
Personal Development: Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes.
Engaging Team Culture: Participate in regular team and company events along with wellness initiatives that help you stay productive, healthy, and engaged in a hybrid work environment.
Urban Sports Club is committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone who applies for a position or already works with us, regardless of their sports preferences, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies Certified as a Great Place to Work® Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance Product Manager PRIMARY PURPOSE : The Product Manager represents the “voice of the client” by maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog that maximizes business value.

This position translates client needs into clear, actionable requirements. The Product Manager will solicit stakeholder input and feedback to inform product decisions and partners closely with the development team to balance functional outcomes with technical feasibility, manage dependencies, and support predictable delivery.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES Set product vision & roadmap Performs external and internal discovery to identify client needs, market opportunities, and business priorities, incorporating technical constraints, platform standards, and architectural considerations into product direction.

Collaborates with Operations, Sales, and Product leadership to ensure strategic alignment, secure sign‑off on key business decisions, and balance functional and technical tradeoffs.

Works with the Product Director to adjust scope, sequencing, and roadmap decisions, ensuring product functionality aligns with both business outcomes and technical feasibility. Defines product outcomes (OKRs), represents the “voice of the client,” and communicates roadmap progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.

Oversee, coordinate & support development work Estimates effort required to complete requests and allocates capacity accordingly. Partner with Product Management and stakeholders to define business and functional requirements and gather necessary inputs. Defines user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritizes backlog to meet sprint goals.

Ensures product strategy, requirements, and priorities are well understood and effectively communicated to development teams, including through intake processes. Understands and helps coordinate intra‑team and external dependencies as applicable.

Collects, tracks, and reports KPI data to support Product Group OKRs and monitor performance metrics such as efficiency and quality. Represent the development team in work related to core delivery, non‑functional requirements, and technical initiatives (e.g., maintenance, support, and technical debt).

Participates in sprint ceremonies and evaluation meetings (e.g., planning, reviews, retrospectives). Contributes to or author IT and product documentation as needed. Tactical Maintains a holistic understanding of business processes and internal system configurations impacting the product and evaluates technical implications of proposed changes.

Assesses business process changes and system impacts to ensure features can be implemented effectively and sustainably. Serves as a primary contact for stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of requirements, risks, assumptions, and delivery decisions.

Provides product expertise, consultation, and support for release readiness, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement activities. ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES Performs other duties as assigned. Travel as required. QUALIFICATIONS Education & Licensing Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university preferred.

Licenses as needed. Experience Eight (8) years’ experience in product strategy, product management or requirements intake role. Experience with agile development is strongly preferred.

Skills & Knowledge knowledge of agile methodologies and tools and experience writing and managing user stories Cross‑functional collaboration, with the ability to build productive relationships with technical and non‑technical partners business and technology acumen, including understanding customer needs, technical concepts, and business strategy Effective communication skills, encompassing clear verbal, written, and presentation communication with diverse stakeholders Analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, assess tradeoffs, and inform decisions Organizational and time management skills, enabling prioritization of work, management of competing demands, and reliable delivery Leadership and influence skills, including people management, negotiation Professional execution and accountability, including producing quality written outputs, working effectively in team environments, and meeting or exceeding performance expectations WORK ENVIRONMENT When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.

Mental : Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines Physical : Computer keyboarding, travel as required Auditory/Visual : Hearing, vision and talking The statements contained in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by a colleague assigned to this description.

They are not intended to constitute a comprehensive list of functions, duties, or local variances. Management retains the discretion to add or to change the duties of the position at any time. Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience.

All our mentors are handpicked through a rigorous selection process so that we can truly be #studentfirst. As a mentor, you will be meeting virtually on a weekly basis with your students for community support, live office hours and other activities.

Product Development, Rapid Prototyping, User-Centered Design, Product Strategy, Go-To-Market Strategy, Basic knowledge of SQL.

Graduate from a Udacity Nanodegree Program is a added plus Experience teaching technical concepts and public speaking, organizing technical talks, or webinars Positive character, trusted by the students, creating emotional ties in the group Flexibility at their current job to take this challenge part-time as an external contractor Responsibilities: Provide technical support for students over an online community forum Answer questions around course content over the forum and facilitate content for students who get stuck in learning Host one weekly live virtual session to offer direct, real-time support to students.

We're on the hunt for skilled product managers who have a unique blend of deep technical understanding, customer obsession and a love for solving product problems. With countless potential features to bring to life in Cint , seize the opportunity to be the decision-maker on one of the most impactful domains within Cint .

What You Will Do Own the Vision: Develop and promote a product vision for your part of Cint ’s Exchange. We make long term investments with large payoffs for success, see the future and articulate it. Tell the Story: Masterfully articulate the "why" behind your product strategy.

Bring complex customer and technical problems to life, inspiring and aligning senior leadership and the broader organization around your vision. Execute with Excellence: Conduct thorough opportunity assessments, backed by data and customer research, to validate assumptions and prioritize initiatives.

Author clear, comprehensive product requirements and partner with R&D leadership to navigate complex technical trade-offs. Partner to Win: Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders across R&D, Data Science, Commercial, Operations, Legal, and Marketing to ensure cross-functional alignment and a successful go-to-market.

What We Are Looking For Proven Product Operator: You have a proven track record of launching, operating and scaling complex products, platforms, or services from concept to market or transforming existing products for their next stage of growth.

Customer-Obsessed: You are an expert in translating customer problems from the ResTech and data space into clear, well-structured product requirements, backed by data and qualitative insights.

Technical Expertise: You have direct experience managing the full lifecycle of API and UI driven products and can also clearly demonstrate shipping high quality experiences. Demonstrated knowledge, experience and interest in how LLMs and modern coding stacks challenge long held verities would be a strong plus.

Exceptional Communicator: You possess outstanding written and verbal communication skills and are seen as an expert storyteller. You can effectively partner with senior leadership and are skilled at managing complex stakeholder maps. Remote First: Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment. Why Join Us?

Strategic Impact: You will be driving the foundation of Cint 's current and future success. Innovation: You will be on the cutting edge of ResTech and data technology, solving novel problems with a world-class R&D team. Global Reach: Cint is a global company with a distributed, flexible, and collaborative culture.

Ownership: We empower our product team. You will have the autonomy and accountability to make a measurable impact on the business. Our Values Collaboration is our superpower We uncover rich perspectives across the world Success happens together We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood We’re pioneers in our industry Our curiosity is insatiable We bring the best ideas to life. We do what we say We’re accountable for our work and actions Excellence comes as standard We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring We learn from each other’s experiences Stop and listen; every opinion matters We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion. More About Cint We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney.

(www.cint.com) Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide . Who We Are Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech).

Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more.

The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 130 countries. At Cint , we are committed to innovation and are rapidly expanding our portfolio of data solutions to power the next generation of insights.

We are looking for passionate, results-oriented leaders to join us on this journey. Originally posted on Himalayas

s.t:
What do a top-of-the-line mountain bike, an artificial hip joint, and a smartphone have in common? We develop the software used to manufacture these high-end products! With hyperMILL®, we control CNC machines and set the highest standards for performance and part quality.
We are one of the world’s leading developers of high-performance CAD/CAM solutions—and have been for more than 30 years! Our innovative CAD/CAM technologies deliver significantly higher performance in the programming process and set international standards in machining.
For our product management team, we are seeking an experienced Product Manager (m/f/d) to start as soon as possible, with a strong understanding of machining processes and 2.5D, 3-axis, and 5-axis machining.
Your main tasks

s.h: Customer Needs Analysis and Market Validation
s.t: Identification, prioritization, and validation of customer requirements, market potential, and technological opportunities in the field of 2.5D, 3-axis, and 5-axis machining
Supporting product development from problem definition and discovery through design to the successful market launch of new features and solutions
Evaluating requirements in terms of customer benefit, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance, as well as actively shaping product strategy
Validating new concepts and solutions through customer feedback, field testing, and structured risk analyses
Collaborating with development, QA, application engineering, support, marketing, and sales to ensure consistent and successful product development

s.h: Product Integration and Accountability for Goals
s.t:
Ensuring the consistent integration of new features in terms of user experience, product strategy, and the overall hyperMILL concept, as well as taking responsibility for achieving defined product goals and the sustainable improvement of customer value
Your profile
In-depth knowledge of machining and a thorough understanding of CAM processes, CNC machines, control systems, tools, and manufacturing processes
Several years of professional experience in CAM, machining, or product management, as well as experience in the development, validation, and market launch of technical product solutions

s.h: Analytical and structured approach to work
s.t: Confident assessment of requirements, risks, and priorities, as well as the ability to present complex technical issues in a clear and understandable manner
Confident interaction with customers, interdisciplinary teams, and stakeholders

Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Civil Industrial, Ingeniero/a en Informática o carrera afín, con experiencia implementando soluciones tecnológicas y productos digitales en el segmento financiero. En TCIT valoramos a profesionales que puedan liderar el “puente” entre negocio y tecnología: traducir necesidades, ordenar el trabajo del equipo y sostener el foco en el resultado.
Requisitos y experiencia
Formación: Ingeniería Industrial, Informática y/o Civil.
Experiencia implementando soluciones tecnológicas y productos digitales en el sector financiero.
Dominio de metodologías ágiles para la gestión de productos y la coordinación con equipos.
Habilidades de comunicación para alinear requerimientos con heads de negocio y stakeholders.
Experiencia en empresas de Banca y/o Fintech.
Manejo de Inglés B1-B2
Competencias y habilidades personales
Orientación a resultados y capacidad para priorizar según valor de negocio.
Pensamiento analítico: ordenar información, gestionar dependencias y detectar riesgos.
Alta coordinación y seguimiento: sostener el backlog, la planificación y la entrega incremental.
Comunicación clara y proactiva, adaptando el lenguaje entre negocio y tecnología.
Colaboración: trabajo efectivo con proveedores, equipos de desarrollo y áreas internas.
Si te entusiasma liderar productos digitales con enfoque en calidad y sostenibilidad, y disfrutas trabajar con equipos ágiles en entornos Cloud, este desafío es para ti.
Nuestra misión es asegurar que las soluciones digitales evolucionen de forma ordenada, medible y alineada al negocio. Tu foco será convertir necesidades y oportunidades en un backlog claro y accionable, liderando la planificación y el seguimiento del producto durante todo su ciclo de vida.

Liderar el ciclo de vida de las soluciones digitales: discovery, definición, planificación, entrega y mejora continua.
Transformar iniciativas de negocio en un backlog claro, priorizado y mantenido (con criterios de valor, alcance y dependencias).
Gestionar el presupuesto del producto/solución, coordinando costos, recursos y planificación con las áreas correspondientes.
Coordinar con proveedores, equipos de desarrollo y stakeholders para asegurar ejecución efectiva y alineamiento.
Definir y hacer seguimiento de objetivos del producto, métricas y resultados esperados, para una gestión basada en datos.
Dominar metodologías ágiles (por ejemplo, Scrum/Kanban) y asegurar prácticas saludables de trabajo con los equipos.
Trabajar con tecnologías Cloud en AWS (u otras), comprendiendo el impacto de decisiones de arquitectura en el producto.
Alinear requerimientos con los heads de negocio, asegurando claridad, trazabilidad y acuerdos sobre alcance.
En este rol, buscamos que aportes criterio para equilibrar valor, esfuerzo y riesgo, manteniendo una comunicación fluida entre negocio, tecnología y terceros.
*Contrato directo con el Cliente
Modalidad inicialmente presencial (3 primeros meses), luego 1-2 días remoto, resto presencial.
Oficinas ubicadas en la Comuna de las Condes, cercano a metro Tobalaba.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Japan. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Japan. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1.

Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

About Remote
Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!
The Position
This is an exciting time to join Remote and build a thriving ecosystem of HRIS integrations as a Senior Product Manager, HRIS Integrations .
Your mission: enable customers to sync their HRIS with Remote's employment infrastructure for Payroll, EOR, and Contractors through reliable, well-designed technical integrations. You will work deeply with Remote’s APIs and partner APIs, translating customer problems into data flows that are accurate, scalable, and easy to use.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success, you will bring the detail orientation, collaboration, and customer judgment needed to build integrations that work exceptionally well, solve real customer problems, and drive customer outcomes.
You report to a Senior Group Product Manager and collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure every HRIS integration succeeds commercially and technically.

Senior-Level Experience: Track record as a Product Manager with a strong focus on Integrations, APIs, or Platform ecosystems .
Customer Focus: Deep empathy for customers and a strong sense of what matters most in their day-to-day workflows.
Partner-Facing Experience: Proven experience building trusted relationships with external organizations and communicating clearly in partner-facing settings.
Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders, navigate trade-offs, and keep teams focused on what matters most for customers.
Strong UX Sensibilities: A passion for effortless experiences. You believe that data syncing, even at scale across jurisdictions, should feel simple and seamless to the end user.
Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code (Required): You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code and prototypes — not just write specs. You can understand sample code, API responses, and integration flows hands-on.
Domain Expertise (HRIS/Payroll - nice to have): Experience with HRIS and payroll platforms (Workday, HiBob, BambooHR, Personio, ADP, Paychex, or similar). You understand data models, sync patterns, and common integration pain points in the space.
Outstanding Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can explain complex technical integrations to non-technical executives and clearly articulate value to external partners.
Language: Business-level proficiency writing and speaking English.

Integration Architecture & Design: Lead deep-dive technical discovery into Remote’s APIs and partner APIs. Understand data mapping, data flows, authentication flows, API keys, edge cases, and compliance requirements across 100+ countries.
Customer-Led Prioritization: Prioritize integration work based on customer needs, product impact, technical feasibility, and operational complexity.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, operations, GTM, sales, CX, and partners. Translate customer and partner requirements into clear technical specs, manage dependencies, and unblock delivery.
Quality & Reliability: Sweat the details of data accuracy, sync reliability, error handling, observability, and supportability so integrations work well in real customer workflows.
Measure Integration Impact: Establish and track KPIs for technical performance and customer outcomes, including adoption, reliability, retention, and customer satisfaction.
Drive Product Feedback: Turn integration learnings into clear, actionable feedback for Remote teams — what to add, fix, and improve across APIs, CLIs, and the product overall.

Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance.

We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging.

As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.
Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.
Role Scope
Habitat Health is hiring its first Data Product Manager to report to the VP of Product. We are looking for a generalist, hands-on, highly technical individual contributor who will own the roadmap for Habitat's data products and infrastructure, setting direction and priorities across the data function. You will own data products end-to-end across the two major Habitat Health pillars that the data team supports:
Platform & Integrations , including Engineering / IT / Product / Technical & AI vendors
Dashboards & Reporting , across growth, clinical, financial, and administrative data sets
In this role you will serve as the key bridge between our Product and Data functions, working closely with C-Suite and VP level stakeholders to align on the right product strategy, then rolling up your sleeves and collaborating with our development team to build data products that align with business needs. To succeed as a Data PM, you will need to balance Habitat’s high level business objectives against end user needs and development constraints.
In a given week you'll move across all of the modes below: figuring out what's actually worth building (Discovery), writing specs precise enough for developers to build from without back-and-forth (Specs), running the Jira backlog and sprint process (Delivery), keeping development unblocked (Execution management), mocking up and shipping dashboards (Design, QC, UAT), and triaging the daily stream of ad hoc requests from a diverse set of data customers (Triage).

s.h: Core Responsibilities & Expectations for the Role
s.t:
Discovery : define the business problem before the build (e.g. is automating LOPMR for CMS audits the right priority this quarter?).
Build and ship : own the full delivery cycle – specs, Jira/sprint process, dashboard design and sign-off, UAT, and rollout.
Hands-on data work : use SQL and Git to independently query, validate, and review code, not just manage a backlog.
Triage : distinguish quick fixes from roadmap work across a steady stream of ad hoc requests.
AI fluency : use AI tools (e.g. Claude) to accelerate the work and model that fluency for the team.
Range : move across all Platform & Integrations, Clinical & Operational Services, Regulatory and Enterprise Reporting, helping shape how data product works at Habitat.

Proficiency in SQL sufficient to independently query, validate, and troubleshoot data.

Familiarity with a modern data development stack (e.g., Jira, Git, Power BI, and cloud data platforms such as Databricks or Azure) sufficient to spec, review, and troubleshoot alongside engineering.

Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and Jira (or similar tools).

About Allica Bank
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
Department Description
Allica Bank aims to provide Expert Banking for Business Britain by providing excellent customer experience and pioneering technology solutions to facilitate this.
The Autonomous Lending tribe runs across multiple business lines including Credit Operations and Underwriting, with a mission to build AI-first lending origination journeys, automating origination capabilities, data flows, and underwriting and operational workflow management.
The tribe is a critical driver for Allica to continue to realise its vision of providing a market leading relationship-based banking experience, at a speed and cost to serve the rest of the market cannot match.
Role Description
The Product Owner will lead the work to define, deliver and manage AI-enabled products across our lending journeys, bringing together product design and thinking with a strong working knowledge of what today’s AI can and cannot do.
You will be accountable for the roadmap of your team and for the full product lifecycle: discovery and design, day-to-day delivery, launch and adoption by colleagues and customers, and how risks are addressed once a product is live. You will aim to build robust, automated and well-governed systems and processes that enable us to move quickly and innovate our lending and financing products in the SME banking market.
Whilst a lot of the market aims to avoid the complex nature of SME businesses, we are going for it head on, designing simple and efficient solutions to the most complex problems in the market to provide excellent and efficient customer experience. We aim for our external view of the lending product, as well as our internal systems to be the best in market which will allow us to scale quickly to serve more UK SMEs, while doing so in a cost-effective manner.
Principal Accountabilities
Responsible for innovation and building end-to-end solutions for AI-enabled lending product, origination, underwriting and operational flows
Lead a small cross-functional team (e.g. a full stack engineer and AI specialist) to deliver your roadmap
Continuously review business needs, refine priorities and iterate towards measurable outcomes – judged on fewer requests for further information, more applications decided with AI, less colleague time per application across underwriting and credit operations, and risk outcomes no worse than the equivalent manual journey
Prototype and experiment quickly – vibe-code working prototypes yourself, close enough to the real thing that an engineer can harden it into production code
Determine the accuracy of AI solutions by analysing the data yourself and building the verified “ground truth” datasets that results are tested against, working with underwriters and credit operations colleagues to agree what a correct answer looks like
Take responsibility for launch and adoption – briefing stakeholders, training the teams who will use the product, and closing the loop on the feedback they give back
Produce the written work that keeps delivery moving and safe – clear descriptions of what we are building and why, a record of the important design decisions and trade-offs made, and the assessments needed to get a product approved and live, covering risk, security, cost, data and legal considerations, and taking the change through the bank’s governance and approval process
Line manage, coach and develop your team, setting a high bar for delivery and for the responsible use of AI
Personal Attributes & Experience
Knowledge of commercial lending origination and underwriting processes, principles and systems
Experience in a fast-moving or high-growth business
Proven track record of delivering agentic and data-driven products into live use
Strong process design, implementation and automation skills
Hands-on familiarity with Python, SQL and data analytics tools, alongside LLM tooling, prompt engineering and AI orchestration – you do not need to be an engineer or an analyst, but you should be able to build something that works, query the data yourself, and understand and sense-check what AI is producing
Understanding of privacy and safety considerations when applying LLMs in production, and of how to prove and monitor accuracy once a solution is live – ideally in a regulated environment
Strong analytical skills and business acumen, comfortable digging into data yourself to size a problem, measure performance and assemble the reference datasets accuracy is judged against
Metric and outcome driven approach – setting the measures up front, tracking them once a product is live, and stopping work that is not moving them
Experience working with or leading product and engineering teams, and comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the problem is as novel as the solution

Do you know what product management is really about? If you do, then you know it isn't roadmaps, tickets or beautifully groomed backlogs. It's finding a real, expensive, unglamorous problem that people live with every day - and shipping something that makes it go away. That is product.
At Shape Construction, we are building software that transforms how construction projects are delivered. It's born out of real project experience and designed to bring clarity, structure and performance to complex environments.
The problem we are solving is one of the oldest in the industry: what actually happens on a construction site never makes it, intact, to the people who need it. Supervisors, field engineers and site managers see reality first: work blocked, plans deviated from, instructions given verbally, conditions nobody planned for.

That knowledge lives in heads, notebooks, camera rolls and group chats. Meanwhile the people responsible for the commercial health of the project are working weeks behind, from whatever fragments they can piece together. By the time anyone needs to prove what happened, the evidence has gone cold.
We are building the platform that closes that gap. Tools the site genuinely wants to use, capturing what happens as it happens, and then turning that raw signal into structured, trustworthy records that let commercial and project leadership make decisions, hold their ground and protect margin they would otherwise have written off.
This is your opportunity to own a core part of that. You won't be handed a roadmap to administer, you'll shape it, defend it, and be measured on whether customers are genuinely better off. If you like being close to messy real-world problems, have strong opinions about what to build and the discipline to kill your own ideas when the evidence says so, keep reading.
(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

As a Product Manager you'll own a core area of the Shape platform end to end, from the customer problem through to the outcome it produces on a live project.
You'll be accountable for a measurable business outcome for our customers, not for a feature list. Our platform spans two very different worlds, and both matter. About Customer Portal
Customer Portal exists to make Veriff's product sell itself. The Portal serves two purposes. It allows our customers to operate Veriff products — setting up and configuring products, consulting verification session details, reporting issues.

And it is a privileged surface for customers to discover, try, buy and expand through a seamless self-serve experience, connecting product usage, onboarding and growth in one place. It unites forces with GTM to automate acquisition, upsell, cross-sell and retention, with end-to-end ownership of the customer persona. The area is evolving fast.

What began as a self-serve growth surface (Station) is becoming the customer-facing window into Veriff's accuracy and fraud advantage for our largest enterprise customers.
The shape of this role
This is an IC-first leadership role, and the first genuine step into product leadership — distinct from a strong senior IC. At first you will lead through craft, authority and influence. You own the strategy, discovery, roadmap and delivery for your product area.
As you refine the strategic themes for this large product, we expect you to propose the team configuration needed to support our growth and company objectives. That will move you progressively from IC to manager, while retaining hands-on ownership of at least one part of the Customer Portal area in the mid-term. We will deliberately assess for both the IC craft bar and the latent management capability, because the role is designed to traverse the line.

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Customer Portal area, tied explicitly to Veriff's commercial model and revenue drivers.
Run disciplined, continuous discovery with customers, and translate it into well-defined problem statements and a sequenced roadmap.
Make transparent prioritisation and trade-off calls across product ambition, technical sustainability and business urgency — especially where capability gaps mean we cannot do everything at once.
Define success metrics before building, and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not output.
Partner as a credible peer to Engineering, GTM, Fraud Ops and Design. Be the connective tissue that turns internal expertise into a customer-facing product.
Own launch as a discipline from the start — internal platform releases and external GTM — not a milestone at the end.
Set and uphold the product-craft bar. Mentor PMs and, in time, build and lead the team.
Champion AI internally, implementing new best practices for faster product discovery and delivery.

You are a product leader who has earned authority through the quality of your thinking rather than a title.
You have owned a product area end-to-end
From strategy through discovery, delivery and launch. You are equally comfortable in the messy front end of a problem and in the discipline of shipping.
You are looking for the step where your impact starts to come through others, and you are excited that this role begins as an individual leader and grows into managing a team — not the other way around.
You think commercially
You instinctively connect what you build to how the business grows, and you explain the “why” behind a product bet in terms of revenue, retention and customer trust, not just features and flows.
You run discovery as a continuous discipline
You get close to customers, including demanding enterprise accounts, and you can tell the difference between what they ask for and what they actually need.
You turn that into sharp problem statements and a phased roadmap where every step delivers a real customer outcome.
You prioritise ruthlessly and transparently
When there are more good ideas than capacity, you make the hard calls about what not to do, and you can articulate the reasoning.
You define success before you build. When something goes wrong, you own it without deflection and change how you work as a result.
You lead through influence, not authority
You build credibility with engineering, go-to-market, design and operations partners as a genuine peer, and you reach good decisions with people who do not report to you.
You stay calm under uncertainty, create space for views that differ from your own, and commit gracefully once a call is made.
You raise the people around you
You set a high craft bar through your own work, share your thinking generously and give specific, useful feedback.
You are motivated by building and leading a team over time, with a realistic understanding that management is a different job — one focused on developing people and multiplying impact, not doing all the work yourself.
You stay current on your craft
You take pride in tracking how product management is evolving, and you consistently find time to experiment and fold what works into your practice.

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing!

With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world.

# Projektleiter/in / Product Owner 80 - 100% #
Du möchtest ein anspruchsvolles Digitalisierungsvorhaben im Bildungsbereich verantworten? Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Fachbereichen, Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteams, kannst komplexe Anforderungen strukturieren und Entscheidungen fundiert vorbereiten und treffen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.
Die Bildungsplanung des Kantons Zürich erhebt bildungsstatistische Daten für mehrere Kantone. Diese bilden eine wichtige Grundlage für die Planung und Steuerung des Bildungswesens.
Als Projektleiter und Product Owner übernimmst du die operative Gesamtverantwortung für die Entwicklung des «BISTA-Portals» und verbindest Projektsteuerung, Produktentwicklung und Requirements Engineering.
### Deine Aufgaben ###
* Du planst, steuerst und priorisierst die Projekt- und Produktentwicklung inklusive Roadmap, Backlog, Ressourcen und Budget.
* Du erhebst, analysierst und strukturierst fachliche, prozessuale und datenseitige Anforderungen und überführst diese in umsetzbare Lösungen.
* Du koordinierst das interdisziplinäre Umsetzungsteam sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Stakeholdern und externen Partnern.
* Du förderst eine agile und selbstorganisierte Zusammenarbeit und verstehst es, in komplexen Situationen Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Entscheidungswege zu klären und gemeinsam mit dem Team weiterzuentwickeln.
* Du konzipierst und moderierst Workshops und Entscheidungsprozesse und begleitest UX, technische Konzeption, Testing und fachliche Abnahme.
* Du verantwortest Projektcontrolling, Risikomanagement und Reporting und stellst die strategische Einbettung des Projekts innerhalb der Direktion sicher.
* Du betreust zudem die bestehenden Applikationen BISS3/4 bis zu deren Ablösung.
### Dein Profil ###
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Projektleitung, Product Ownership oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im digitalen Umfeld.

* Erfahrung mit agilen Vorgehensweisen, insbesondere Scrum und Kanban.
* Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für komplexe organisatorische Zusammenhänge.
* Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen oder lateralen Führung.
* Selbstständige, strukturierte und resultatorientierte Arbeitsweise.
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.
* Kenntnisse in Azure DevOps, HERMES oder entsprechende Zertifizierungen sind von Vorteil.
### Unser Angebot ###
Wir bieten dir eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit grossem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem interdisziplinären Team. Dich erwarten ein zentral gelegener Arbeitsplatz in Zürich, moderne Arbeitsbedingungen sowie zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen und Sozialleistungen nach kantonalen Richtlinien.

Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.
This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides.

You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption.

You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.

Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.
Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.
Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.
Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.
Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.
Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.
Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.
Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.

A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.
Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.
The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.
Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.
A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.
Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.
What you’ll need
Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.
Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.
The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.
The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.
Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.
Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.
What success looks like
Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.
Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its governance and scale, and the market clearly understands its unique value because you've communicated it effectively.

s.h: Who is American College of Education
s.t:
Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.
ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.
We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.
The Product Manager, Student Acquisition owns the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the end-to-end student acquisition journey/value stream from prospective student through started student.

This role serves as the strategic bridge among Marketing, Enrollment, Admissions, Student Services, and IT, translating institutional growth goals and student needs into a prioritized, outcome-based product roadmap. The Product Manager aligns people, processes, data, and technology across the student acquisition technology ecosystem.

Success is measured through improved funnel conversion, faster decision-making and delivery, stronger operational efficiency, better prospective student experience, and clear accountability for the value delivered by technology investments.

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $145,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.
What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate
Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:
Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success measures for the Student Acquisition value stream, aligned with institutional enrollment, revenue, and student experience goals.
Own the end-to-end prospect-to-started-student journey; use research, journey mapping, funnel data, and stakeholder feedback to identify friction, unmet needs, and improvement opportunities.
Establish and monitor product objectives and key performance indicators, including speed-to-lead, stage conversion, application completion, yield, cycle time, adoption, data quality, and operational efficiency.
Prioritize initiatives across the product ecosystem based on expected business value, student impact, risk, cost, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment; make transparent trade-off recommendations.
Translate business problems and desired outcomes into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and decision context for Product Owners, delivery teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
Partner with Product Owners and technology teams to sequence delivery, manage cross-platform dependencies, validate releases, and confirm that delivered capabilities achieve intended outcomes.
Guide product discovery, experimentation, usability testing, and continuous optimization; apply quantitative and qualitative evidence to product decisions.
Ensure consistent funnel definitions, lead qualification rules, attribution, consent, and data flow across channels and platforms in partnership with data and business owners.
Own the integrated product roadmap across CRM, marketing automation, digital experience, inquiry and application, communications, workflow, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
Evaluate platform capabilities, vendors, and investment options; develop business cases and recommendations that address value, total cost, scalability, reliability, integration, and technical debt.
Align Marketing, Enrollment, Admissions, Student Services, IT, and executive stakeholders around priorities, decisions, risks, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
Partner with operational leaders on process design, service levels, adoption, training, change management, and readiness for peak enrollment cycles.
Ensure product decisions support FERPA, privacy, consent, accessibility, security, data governance, responsible AI, and other applicable institutional requirements.
Communicate roadmap progress, product performance, financial impact, risks, dependencies, and decisions to executive and operational audiences.

Bachelor's degree in business, technology, marketing, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Five or more years of experience in product management, digital product strategy, business technology, CRM, enrollment technology, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience owning a product strategy and roadmap across multiple platforms, business functions, and stakeholder groups.
Experience using product discovery, customer research, journey mapping, experimentation, and data analysis to prioritize work and improve measurable outcomes.
Strong working knowledge of CRM and lead management, marketing automation, digital experience, workflow, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
Proven ability to define meaningful product metrics, interpret funnel and operational data, build business cases, and evaluate value, cost, risk, and trade-offs.
Experience partnering with Product Owners and Agile delivery teams; ability to translate strategy and business problems into outcome-based requirements without prescribing technical solutions.

The Ads Auction system sits at the heart of this exchange, determining which ads are shown for every opportunity.
The Ads Marketplace team is responsible for the core engine that drives Yelp 's advertising business. We develop and optimize the sophisticated auction, bidding, and pacing systems that balance advertiser value (ROI), consumer experience, and Yelp 's monetization goals. We work at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and large-scale systems engineering.
As the Principal Product Manager for Ads Auction and Measurement, you will own the product strategy and execution for Yelp 's core ad auction, bidding, pricing, budget pacing mechanisms, and corresponding measurements.

This is a highly technical leadership role where you will guide the evolution of algorithms and systems that make real-time decisions maximizing value across multiple stakeholders. You will define how we measure the performance and impact of these complex systems, focusing on both short-term efficiency and long-term impact.

You will partner closely with world-class engineering and applied science teams to design, experiment, implement, and iterate on auction dynamics and the metrics that guide our progress.
This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular area in Canada. We welcome applicants from throughout Canada. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp , we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

Auction Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product roadmap for Yelp 's ads auction, bidding algorithms, pricing mechanisms, and budget pacing systems, ensuring alignment with business objectives and competitive dynamics. Identify key levers for optimization and innovation.
Algorithm & System Optimization: Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science to design, develop, and refine the auction-based ad selection system. Translate advertiser goals (ROI, leads, conversions), user experience, and monetization considerations into algorithmic requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on concrete data and expected impact.
Auction Measurement & Evaluation: Define and own the key metrics framework for evaluating auction health, efficiency, and the business impact. Drive the development of robust measurement for complex trade-offs (e.g., relevance vs. monetization, short-term vs. long-term effects). Design and interpret large-scale A/B tests.
Independent Data Analysis: Conduct hands-on analysis of large-scale auction and advertising datasets using tools like SQL and Python to uncover optimization opportunities, validate hypotheses, understand performance drivers, and inform product decisions.
Technical Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for auction-related features and improvements, from ideation and requirements definition through launch and iteration.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the product leader for the auction domain, collaborating effectively with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Finance, and other Product teams. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences.
Drive Business Impact: Directly influence Yelp 's revenue and advertiser success by improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the core ad marketplace.

Experience: 8+ years of technical product management experience, preferably focused on auctions, bidding systems, search ranking, or monetization platforms within the online advertising (AdTech) industry.
Auction & Optimization Expertise: Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with auction theory (e.g., VCG, GSP), optimization algorithms, statistical modeling, and machine learning concepts relevant to ad targeting and ranking.
Advanced Analytical & Data Skills: Proven ability to independently query, manipulate, and analyze large, complex datasets. Proficiency with SQL and data analysis tools/languages (e.g., Python, R) is required.
Statistical Rigor: Deep understanding of applied statistics, experimental design (A/B testing), causal inference, and methods for measuring statistical significance and inferring long-term impact.
Educational Background: Strong quantitative background; Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related field is highly preferred.
Technical Fluency: Ability to engage deeply with engineers and data scientists on technical details of algorithms, system design, and data infrastructure.
Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across various functions.
Problem Solving: Strong structured thinking and problem-solving abilities, capable of breaking down complex problems into actionable components.
